Bokförda rader med projektet på resultat: Posted rows with the project on income statement accounts in every fiscal year. The contribution is the revenue minus the costs of material, external services and personnel (accounts 4000–7699).
Du ser resultatet för de projekt du har: You see the results of the projects you have access to. Ask the owner or an administrator to add them under Access per unit.
Hela projektets bokförda intäkter och ko: The whole project's posted revenue and costs compared with the contract sum and the estimated total cost in the project register.
Inga bokförda rader på kontot för period: No posted rows on the account for the period. The amount comes from the budget.
Intäkter visas positiva och kostnader ne: Revenue is shown positive and costs negative, as in the income statement. The budget is the rows with the project in the budget the reports use. Variance is actual minus budget. Click an account to see its rows.
Revenue is shown positive and costs negative, as in the income statement. Click an account to see its rows.
Intäkter, kostnader och täckningsbidrag: Revenue, costs and contribution for every project, against budget and estimate.
Lägg upp projekt under Bokföring → Proje: Add projects under Bookkeeping → Projects and choose them on the rows when you post or invoice.
Personalkostnader (konto 7000–7699) visa: Personnel costs (accounts 7000–7699) are not shown, neither outcome nor budget, because you are limited to certain cost centres and projects. The contribution and the result are therefore higher than in the books.
När du väljer projektet på rader i verif: When you choose the project on rows in vouchers, supplier invoices or customer invoices, the result is shown here.
Projektet har ingen kontraktssumma eller: The project has no contract sum or estimated total cost. Fill them in under Details in the project register, and the outcome is compared with them here.
Projektets resultat mot budget och kalky: The project's result against budget and estimate.
Ser rapporterna och projektresultaten fö: Sees the reports and project results for the cost centres and projects they are limited to, and nothing else.
Utfallet per månad under räkenskapsåret,: The outcome per month in the fiscal year, in whole kronor.
Visar de första :count raderna. Resten f: Showing the first :count rows. The rest are in the general ledger.
